name: Knott's Calico Saloon Cold Old-Fashioned Sarsaparilla / Root Beer
whyItWorks: Knott's historic signature beverage served in a frosty mug. Made with real cane sugar and natural birch/sassafras extracts with 100% zero caffeine and zero citrus acids.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an Old-Fashioned Sarsaparilla in a cup; sip slowly to allow carbonation to settle.
watchOuts: Carbonation can cause mild fullness; sip at a leisurely pace
